name: Startup Collections

sources.title: Submit Product page — form renders 'Loading…' behind an imunify bot check

requirements: Site collects 'great tools and resources for starters' across ~45 curated collections (dev tools, productivity, design, crypto, marketing, SEO, etc.)
Submission form is JS-rendered and gated by an imunify bot-check, so fields could not be inspected
preparation: Product/tool name, URL, description, and the best-fit 'collection' (category) from their list
JavaScript-capable browser — the form does not render to plain fetchers
workflow: Open https://startupcollections.com/submit-product/ in a real browser and clear the bot check
Choose the relevant collection and fill the submit form
watchFor: Form is hidden behind JavaScript and an imunify-bot-check interstitial — automated/text-only submission is unlikely to work
An 'Advertise on Startup Collections' page exists separately — advertising is distinct from a free listing
Site looks lightly maintained; pricing/free status of listings is not published
countsAsLive: The tool appears inside the relevant collection page on startupcollections.com
unknowns: Whether submission is free or paid
Whether the site is still actively curating submissions
